## Learning goal

Assess an expression-only reconstruction against independent Jain exchange directions without comparing incompatible absolute units. The primary procedure is **grouped leave-one-exchange-out cross-validation (LOOCV) of a direction classifier built from GEM features**. The canonical reconstruction itself remains a fixed, untuned mechanistic baseline.

## 1. Preflight and isolation audit

Run this from the `exercises/` directory. The workflow rejects unsuffixed or provenance-mismatched contexts and checks that the canonical MCF7 and GTEx WT solves are optimal, positive, and residual-valid.

```{r}
root <- c(".", "..")
root <- root[file.exists(file.path(root, "R/model_io.R"))][1]
if (is.na(root)) stop("Open from the session root or this Task 6 folder.")
root <- normalizePath(root)
setwd(root)
source(file.path(root, "R/exercise6_workflow.R"))
result <- exercise6_run(root)
result$preflight$preflight
```

**Run this:** inspect the preflight table and the RDS/FVA provenance fields.

**Expected result:** the source model hash is consistent, the MCF7 scenario is `MCF7_ACH_000019_Jain`, the objective is `obj_biomass` with maximization, and Jain measurements are absent from reconstruction and medium provenance.

**Interpretation:** MCF7 DepMap expression uses an assumption-based RPMI proxy; GTEx breast uses a Keibler/DMEM proxy. These are unmatched source contexts, not tumor/normal validation.

## 2. Isolate eligible observations

```{r}
obs <- result$observations$observations
data.frame(source_rows = nrow(obs), source_row_ids = length(unique(obs$source_row_id)),
  exchange_groups = length(unique(obs$normalized_exchange_id)),
  units = paste(unique(obs$rate_unit), collapse = ";"))
table(obs$observed_group_direction)
head(obs[, c("source_row_id", "replicate", "method", "metabolite", "rate_in_cobra_exchange_sign", "normalized_exchange_id", "observed_group_direction")])
```

**Run this:** verify both Jain replicates remain present and that `source_row_id` is unique.

**Expected result:** 86 MCF7 rows form 43 exchange groups. Jain values remain in `fmol/cell/h`; negative COBRA-sign values mean uptake and positive values mean secretion.

**Interpretation:** no cells-to-gDW conversion is available, so this exercise evaluates direction only. Discordant or near-zero replicate groups remain `near_zero_or_ambiguous`.

## 3. Fixed expression-only baseline

```{r}
result$classification[, c("exchange_reaction_id", "observed_group_direction", "fba_flux",
  "fva_minimum", "fva_maximum", "model_allowed_direction", "fixed_model_category")]
result$coverage
```

**Run this:** inspect the FVA interval and status before reading any LOOCV score.

**Expected result:** all 43 eligible MCF7 Jain exchange groups are supported by fresh full-panel FVA. Model fluxes are in `mmol/gDW/h`, and FVA intervals are model allowance, not measured-rate predictions.

## 4. Understand one grouped fold

```{r}
result$folds[1, ]
result$folds[result$folds$scoreable, ][1, ]
utils::read.csv(file.path(root, "Task6_validation", "outputs", "grouped_loocv_fold_assignments.csv"))[1, ]
```

**Run this:** compare the held-out exchange and its source-row IDs with the training exchange IDs.

**Expected result:** every replicate for one exchange is held out together; no held-out source row, exchange ID, analyte, method, or replicate appears in training. Scaling and centroids are fitted on training groups only.

## 5. Run grouped LOOCV and compare baselines

```{r}
result$metrics
table(result$folds$scoreable, result$folds$unscored_reason, useNA = "ifany")
utils::read.csv(file.path(root, "Task6_validation", "outputs", "loocv_confusion_matrix.csv"))
```

**Run this:** report the scoreable denominator, ambiguous held-out folds, unsupported folds, and failed folds separately.

**Expected result:** 43 outer exchange groups are retained; 40 folds are scoreable and 3 are ambiguous because of held-out replicate labels. The fold-trained classifier and training-fold majority baseline use only scoreable held-out groups for metrics.

**Interpretation:** this is LOOCV of a direction classifier built from GEM features. It is not LOOCV of the expression reconstruction, and it is not absolute-rate validation. A majority baseline is recomputed inside each training fold.

## 6. Compare model accuracy and confusion matrices

```{r}
utils::read.csv(file.path(root, "Task6_validation", "outputs", "model_accuracy_summary.csv"))
utils::read.csv(file.path(root, "Task6_validation", "outputs", "mcf7_jain_confusion_matrix.csv"))
utils::read.csv(file.path(root, "Task6_validation", "outputs", "gtex_keibler_confusion_matrix.csv"))
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(root, "Task6_validation", "outputs", "model_confusion_matrices.png"))
```

**Expected result:** MCF7/Jain accuracy is **35/40 = 87.5%**; GTEx/Keibler accuracy is **9/10 = 90.0%**. Three MCF7 groups and eight GTEx groups are ambiguous and excluded from their respective accuracy denominators.

**Interpretation:** these are grouped LOOCV accuracies for direction classifiers built from model-derived features. They are not absolute-flux accuracy or clinical/model validity claims.

## 7. Inspect figures and limitations

```{r}
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(root, "Task6_validation", "outputs", "measured_direction_vs_model_allowed.png"))
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(root, "Task6_validation", "outputs", "coverage_status.png"))
knitr::include_graphics(file.path(root, "Task6_validation", "outputs", "loocv_predictions_observed.png"))
```

The plots retain ambiguous and unscored states. The GTEx/Keibler assessment uses all 900 mapped Keibler rows across 18 exchange groups, but its source units are unstated and its tissue/culture sources are unmatched. Do not use Exercise 4 KO or Exercise 5 pair-screen outcomes as validation evidence; they remain downstream model hypotheses. Do not claim matched normal validation, tumor specificity, clinical utility, correlation, or absolute-rate agreement.

## Submission

Submit the generated `Task6_validation/outputs/` tables and figures, the scoreable denominator and coverage counts, and a short interpretation that names the validated procedure precisely: **LOOCV of a direction classifier built from GEM features**, with a fixed expression-only FBA/FVA assessment as the untuned baseline.
